metadata_system.name: SVG Metadata
metadata_system.used_for: Vector graphics — Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG 1.1 + SVG 2)
metadata_system.spec_source: W3C SVG 2 + SVG 1.1 specs (via wooorm/svg-element-attributes — fetched 2026-04-30)
metadata_system.description: SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics) is a W3C XML-based vector image format. Unlike raster formats (JPG/PNG/HEIC), an SVG file is structured markup describing geometric primitives, paths, text, filters, animations, and styling. This entry covers all 90 elements with their full attribute lists from SVG 1.1, SVG Tiny 1.2, and SVG 2 (4,089 element-attribute pairs total), all 20 path data commands, common Inkscape / Adobe Illustrator extension attributes encountered in real-world files, and document-level XML declarations.
